input.question: What is the historical period associated with the John Mason House?

documents.text: and 1871 this house was purchased by George Thurlow . This property remained in the Thurlow family until the mid-twentieth century . NWB.571 Benjamin Coker House , 172 State St. Newburyport MA c 1700 The Benjamin Coker House embodies in its roof frame and second story tie beam , clear evidence of a distinctive First Period plan type and construction methods . While the house is undocumented before 1719 , the style and construction suggest a ca . 1700 date . The house began as a single cell , two story house , located at High and Federal Streets .
